2026_03_KC_MIA.headline: Mahomes takes Kansas City’s unbeaten start into Miami’s speed test
2026_03_KC_MIA.paragraph1: Patrick Mahomes takes a 2-0 Chiefs team on the road for the first time this season, with Travis Kelce still central to how Kansas City solves coverage in the middle of the field. Miami needs Tua Tagovailoa to answer with sustained offense rather than relying on isolated explosive plays, because the Chiefs have repeatedly shown they can survive close games. The Dolphins’ best chance is to create pace and space without letting Mahomes control the game’s most important possessions.
2026_03_KC_MIA.model_rationale: Kansas City has the steadier late-down structure behind Mahomes, while Miami needs Tagovailoa to create sustained drives and keep the Chiefs from owning the game’s leverage moments.
